title: Machine learning on vesicle flow cytometry predicts high-grade prostate cancer
summary: The authors combined microscale flow cytometry of circulating extracellular vesicles with a machine learning platform (EVMAP) to build predictive models from tissue- and disease-specific biomarkers. They developed a blood test for high-grade prostate cancer and validated it in a prospective cohort of 215 patients. The abstract reports that EVMAP models significantly improved prediction of high-risk prostate cancer but gives no numeric performance values.
ai_technology: EVMAP, a machine learning analysis platform for extracellular vesicle microscale flow cytometry data

evidence.tested: Validation in a prospectively collected 215-patient cohort; classified as retrospective evaluation because a frozen-model prospective test is not described.
evidence.unknown: No performance numbers in the abstract; single cohort; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: ML models predict high-grade prostate cancer from vesicle cytometry data.
